underlying_goal: Integrate legacy reverse-sync into the product indexing pipeline so that legacy sync happens before new ES indexing, within a Kotlin/Spring Boot hexagonal architecture project
friction_detail: Claude initially proposed modifying the listener and using inbound-adapter mapper, but user guided toward keeping changes within the application layer without listener modifications, requiring multiple plan revisions.
brief_summary: User wanted to integrate legacy reverse-sync before ES indexing in the product application service; after several plan iterations guided by user feedback, Claude converged on a clean 2-file solution at the correct architectural layer.
